purpose: Teach: 前列/鮓/峪/壱/魏/起る/不確か/組成

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、講演の前列、つまり前列席の聴衆動向の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, your paper examined audience behaviour in front-row seating at lectures, didn't it?
lines.style: Warm, curious tone. Gentle opening. Measured pace. Inviting confirmation without pressure, like checking in with a student you trust.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、寿司、つまり鮓、つまり古い表記の鮓の食文化研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the food culture of sushi, the historical writing of it, actually.
lines.style: Steady, attentive response. Direct eye contact. Slight pause before the clarification, showing she's thought this through. Genuine, not rehearsed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 山の峪、つまり峪の地形研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And your work on mountain valleys — the topography of those formations — that was quite thorough.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Slight nod. Warm acknowledgment. Pace relaxes mid-sentence, like she's recalling the paper with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、旧字「壱」、つまり一の用法研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I studied the usage of the old character for one — the linguistic evolution of how it's written.
lines.style: Clear, confident delivery. Slight emphasis on the technical detail. Present, not defensive. Shows mastery of her own work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 三国時代の魏王朝の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your research on the Wei Dynasty of the Three Kingdoms period — that was ambitious work.
lines.style: Steady, respectful tone. Slight lean back, giving space for the answer. Recognition of the scope. Not quite a question, more a gentle observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、事件が起る、つまり「起る」の用法の言語学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the linguistic usage of the verb 'to occur' — how it appears in historical texts.
lines.style: Composed, precise articulation. Matter-of-fact delivery. She's stated her findings clearly before. Quiet confidence, no overstatement.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 感染症の不確かさを巡る疫学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And then there was your epidemiology work — the uncertainty around infectious disease transmission patterns.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly slower pace. Genuine curiosity in the voice. Slight warmth, acknowledging the complexity of the subject matter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、岩石の組成分析の地質学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I completed a geological analysis of rock composition and mineral structure.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly quieter. Satisfied closure. Small breath before the period, like the end of a satisfying conversation. Present but winding down.
